title: The radio beside Phil
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: The close quilt and dark wood recede to a small table. Keep the radio a real object in a room when our view moves to Phil’s eyes.

title: Two planes in the inn
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: Phil’s lowered gaze and a second person framed against the dark wood make the lobby feel inhabited beyond him.

title: Rita on assignment
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: Rita’s face reads clearly against a soft crowd. Give our producer the same clear eyeline while her hand asks for thirty seconds.

title: Rita and the camera
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: The profile and ENG camera establish who is working. Leave space between Rita and the rig so her thirty-second signal reads.

title: Ned stops Phil
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: Phil at frame left, Ned facing him on the right. Leave the space between their coats legible.

title: Ned looks for recognition
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: Read Ned’s forward pitch under the brim. The change comes when Phil gives him time to finish.

title: Rita listens
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: Hold her three-quarter listening eyeline long enough for the answer to register.

title: Rita hears Phil play
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · distributor still, Snap/Rex/Shutterstock
note: Phil plays at foreground right, Rita watches from center-left. In our ballroom the crowd gives way to the chair she pulls up herself.

title: The next morning together
credit: Groundhog Day (1993) · Columbia Pictures · film reference
note: The bed holds two lives. Keep Rita offscreen for her first words so we discover the change from inside Phil’s point of view.
